name: swarm-pane
description: A pane beside the transcript showing every running subagent with its model, effort and elapsed time, plus the session's task list.

tasks.title: Task list source
tasks.description: Where the task list comes from when the session writes none: 'auto' reads the newest plan folder and, failing that, asks a small model to read the conversation; 'plan' reads the plan folder only; 'off' leaves the section empty.

dock.title: Ask for the docking renderer
dock.description: Whether the pane asks for the fullscreen renderer, the only layout that seats a pane beside the transcript: 'auto' asks once, the first time the pane opens on the main screen, and the switch restarts and resumes the session; 'off' leaves your renderer alone and the pane sits above the prompt.

heading.title: Section heading colour
heading.description: The colour of the bar behind each section heading: a theme key ('subtle', 'inactive', 'claude', 'success'...), which follows your light or dark theme, or a hex colour, which does not. 'off' draws the old plain heading with a rule after it.

background.title: Pane background colour
background.description: A colour to fill the whole pane with, a theme key or a hex; empty leaves the pane on your terminal's own background. A fill also covers whatever transparency or background image the terminal draws under that column.
